nodes.description: msg.sender: caller address used for permission checks, ownership and node/validator identity checks
block.timestamp / now: drives cooldowns, reward periods, DKG complaint deadlines and delegation months
Pricing.price: current SKL price for schain creation, updated by adjustPrice
Pricing.lastUpdated: last timestamp when price was recalculated
SkaleDKG.channels: channel state (active, n, startedBlockTimestamp) per group
SchainsInternal.schains: mapping of schain data (owner, lifetime, partOfNode, deposit)
SchainsInternal.sumOfSchainsResources: aggregate resources occupied by schains
Punisher._locked: per-holder amount of slashed tokens locked
Nodes.nodes: array of node records
DelegationController.delegations: array of delegation records indexed by delegation id
Distributor._bountyPaid: validator/month bounty accounting used for withdrawals
ContractManager.contracts: registry name-hash to implementation address used for all cross-contract lookups
ConstantsHolder.launchTimestamp: network launch time controlling bounty eligibility
Bounty._stagePool: remaining reward pool for the current stage
OwnableUpgradeSafe._owner: privileged owner address for onlyOwner functions
AccessControlUpgradeSafe._roles: role membership mapping backing access control
KeyStorage._data: broadcasted DKG secret key contributions and verification vectors
TokenLaunchLocker._locked: locked token amount per holder used for delegation limits
ECDH._N: secp256k1 field prime constant used in modular arithmetic
Nodes.spaceOfNodes: free space bookkeeping per node
SchainsInternal.schainsAtSystem: array of all schain ids, mutated on removal
Pricing.totalNodes: cached number of online nodes
Address.sendValue: forwards ETH to a recipient with a low-level call
ECDSA.recover: recovers signer address from signature via ecrecover with malleability checks
Precompiled.bigModExp: modular exponentiation via staticcall to precompile 0x05
Precompiled.bn256Pairing: pairing check via staticcall to precompile 0x08
Pricing.adjustPrice: time-gated price recalculation based on network load and capacity
Pricing.checkAllNodes: refreshes cached online node count
Pricing._getTotalLoad: iterates all schains and sums their load
Schains.addSchain: creates a schain from abi-decoded calldata, restricted to SkaleManager
Schains.deleteSchain: removes schain, returns space to nodes, restricted to SkaleManager
SchainsInternal.initializeSchain: writes schain record with block.timestamp and increments numberOfSchains
SchainsInternal._generateGroup: pseudo-random node group selection using blockhash
SkaleDKG.broadcast: node submits verification vector and secret key contributions
SkaleDKG.complaint: timestamp-driven complaint handling and slashing
SkaleDKG.response: accused node responds with secret number and multiplied share
SkaleDKG._finalizeSlashing: rotates node and slashes via Punisher/SlashingTable
SkaleDKG.alright: marks a node as having received all data and finalizes successful DKG
Punisher.slash: confiscates stake through DelegationController, restricted to SkaleDKG
Punisher.forgive: admin-only reduction of locked slashed amounts
DelegationController.delegate: creates delegation proposal with multiple validator checks
DelegationController.confiscate: applies slashing coefficient to all delegations of a validator
DelegationController.requestUndelegation: computes end month and removes delegation statistics
Distributor.tokensReceived: ERC777 hook that decodes userData and distributes bounty
Distributor.withdrawBounty: transfers earned bounty to a destination address
Nodes.createNode: validates node parameters and appends to nodes array
Nodes.removeSpaceFromNode: subtracts occupied space from a node's free space
NodeRotation.selectNodeToGroup: pseudo-random selection of a replacement node
NodeRotation.rotateNode: removes node from schain and inserts a new one
Monitors.sendVerdict: validates verdict timing before recording metrics
TokenLaunchLocker.getAndUpdateLockedAmount: time and proof-of-use dependent locked balance
ValidatorService.registerValidator: registers caller as validator with fee rate checks
ContractManager.setContractsAddress: owner-only update of the contract registry
SkaleManager.getBounty: node owner claims bounty, triggers token payout
SkaleManager.nodeExit: permission-checked node exit workflow
Bounty.getBounty: computes and reduces bounty from the stage pool
KeyStorage.verify: verifies a multiplied share against the verification vector and secret
AccessControlUpgradeSafe.grantRole: admin-checked role granting
OwnableUpgradeSafe.transferOwnership: owner-only ownership transfer
recipient.call{value: amount}("") low-level ETH transfer with only a success require
ecrecover(hash, v, r, s) signature recovery on attacker-influenced bytes
staticcall to precompile 0x05 with attacker-influenced base/power/modulus
staticcall to precompile 0x08 with attacker-supplied curve points
now.sub(lastUpdated): timestamp-derived arithmetic feeding price change
price.sub(priceChange) / additions on price with SafeMath reverts under flow
_stagePool.sub(bounty) and reward-count arithmetic in Bounty.getBounty
IERC777(skaleToken).send(...) transfers tokens and triggers recipient hooks (reentrancy surface)
skaleToken.transfer(to, bounty) outbound token transfer
punisher.handleSlash(...) external accounting call executed during slash processing
freeSpace.sub(space).toUint8() space accounting arithmetic
keccak256(blockhash(block.number - 1), schainId) used as pseudo-random node selection
keccak256(blockhash(block.number.sub(1)), schainId) used to generate schain groups
node rotation plus Punisher.slash with penalty from SlashingTable during DKG finalization
recipient address parameter of Address.sendValue
amount parameter of Address.sendValue controlling the transferred value
hash parameter of ECDSA.recover
signature bytes parameter of ECDSA.recover parsed via assembly
priceChange local variable computed from load diff, time skipped and capacity
timeSkipped local variable derived from now.sub(lastUpdated)
load accumulator local variable in Pricing._getTotalLoad
schainId parameter of NodeRotation.selectNodeToGroup
random local variable seeded from blockhash in _generateGroup
validatorId parameter of DelegationController.confiscate
amount parameter of Punisher.slash propagated to confiscate
bounty local variable in SkaleManager.getBounty
index local variable resolving node position in the DKG group during broadcast
